question: Do tokenizer changes require identical epoch/LR, and what constitutes a fair scratch-model comparison?
selection: Targeted method comparison, not an exhaustive systematic review. Only original papers and official publication/code sources used.
search_queries: tokenizer evaluation fair comparison learning rate training tokens FLOPs
Getting the most out of your tokenizer training
Scaling Laws with Vocabulary training details

dagan2024.training_data_control: Report both 500B token-equivalent and same-character word-equivalent evaluations.
dagan2024.learning_rate_policy: Shared base configurations use LR 3e-4. Data-size experiment retains other hyperparameters and adjusts the LR schedule to the reduced dataset.
dagan2024.limitation: These include tokenizer switching and domain adaptation; the 500B budget does not prescribe settings for a 221-PDE scratch experiment.

schmidt2024.training_data_control: Appendix B specifies 100000 batches at roughly 2M tokens per global batch, about 200B tokens.
schmidt2024.learning_rate_policy: Common LR 3e-4, AdamW, cosine decay, 5% warmup for listed 350M experiments.
schmidt2024.limitation: Shared token and step budgets do not imply equal raw-character exposure. A common recipe does not establish per-tokenizer optimality.

lotz2025.location: Section 3.2; Appendix A Tables 7-8; final limitations
lotz2025.training_data_control: Train one epoch of the same FineWeb subset, described in units of 100B GPT-2 tokens; global batch is 2M tokens. Report differing parameters and GPU hours.
lotz2025.learning_rate_policy: For smaller model scale pilot results motivate common peak LR 9e-4 rather than 3e-4; Table 8 distinguishes scales.
lotz2025.limitation: The paper states it does not explore sensitivity to downstream hyperparameter configurations or pretraining-pipeline variations. The footnote on cross-validated hyperparameters concerns a predictive SVM, not LM pretraining.

rust2021.location: Appendix A.5, distinguishing scratch models from embedding-retraining arms
rust2021.training_data_control: Scratch monolingual models: 1M steps, batch64, sequence length128 then512. Separate multilingual embedding-retraining arms use250k steps.
rust2021.learning_rate_policy: Scratch models warm up to LR1e-4 for10k steps, then linear decay.
rust2021.limitation: Do not combine the separate 250k embedding-only adaptation recipe with claims about all-parameter scratch training.

tao2024.training_data_control: Separate vocabulary/non-vocabulary parameters, express raw data in characters, compare along equal-FLOPs budgets.
tao2024.learning_rate_policy: Appendix gives common maximum LR4e-4 decaying to4e-5, global batch512.
tao2024.limitation: Scaling experiments do not supply a rule requiring a different LR whenever vocabulary size changes.

inference: No universal requirement that all settings match, and no universal rule that vocabulary changes require new LR. Equal-search validation is our proposed protocol, not a procedure claimed for all cited studies.
